items.post_title_orig: I get to look at this every time I go number one in my downstairs bathroom. It makes me smile every single time.
items.post_selftext:
Of course I’m not looking at Eddie Vedder singing at Wrigley Field every time I go number one, but I look at that amazing poster and I remember those two amazing nights. I can’t wait to see the boys again. 
    submitted by    /u/uncwbrad
